commitResults.messageBody:
Old loading methods load `ContactAssignment` objects without error handling, resulting in possibly orphaned records of links between missing contacts or missing assignments.

This PR fixes the aforementioned issue by throwing errors if such orphaned records are found during loading, and falls back to the usual behaviour for when loading corrupted load files, which is to cancel loading and refresh the address book with an empty one.
